title: Standard-spec material census across all 9 named protocols -- premise correction (AMBA/PCIe/MIPI/eMMC/SD/CAN-FD/Ethernet all have real local specs too)
summary: Broad search under D:\DV\Task\ (not just USB\DOC) found real, genuine standard-spec PDFs for ALL 9 protocols named in the intake task, contradicting the task premise that only USB has real material. AMBA: D:\DV\Task\UVM\Spec\AMBA AXI\IHI0022K_amba_axi_protocol_spec.pdf (ARM AMBA AXI/ACE protocol spec rev K) plus AXI4-Stream IHI0051A/B under 'AMBA AXI stream'. USB: D:\DV\Task\USB\DOC\usb_20.pdf, 'USB 3.2 Revision 1.1.pdf', UTMI-PLUS-SPECIFICATION.pdf, extensible-host-controler-interface-usb-xhci.pdf (deep-extracted, see separate records), plus DWC_usb31_databook_WM-25380.pdf and usb3-phy-interface-pci-express-paper.pdf (PIPE spec, not yet deep-extracted). PCIe: D:\DV\Task\UVM\Spec\PCIE\PCIe-gen-4.pdf and PCIe-gen-5.pdf -- NOTE the parallel D:\DV\Task\PCIe\ directory that mirrors the USB/CAN/MIPI top-level layout is completely EMPTY; real PCIe material lives only under the separate UVM\Spec\ tree, not under PCIe\Spec\. Same empty-top-level-dir pattern applies to D:\DV\Task\AMBA\ (only an empty examples\ subdir) -- AMBA material is likewise only under UVM\Spec\. MIPI-CSI2: D:\DV\Task\MIPI_CSI\Spec\mipi_CSI-2_specification_v4-0.pdf and mipi_C-PHY_specification_v2-1.pdf (duplicated at top-level D:\DV\Task\Spec\). MIPI-DSI: D:\DV\Task\MIPI_DSI\Spec\mipi_DSI-2_specification_v2-1.pdf and mipi_D-PHY_specification_v3-5.pdf (also duplicated at D:\DV\Task\Spec\). eMMC/MMC: the real JEDEC standard is D:\DV\Task\UVM\Spec\Storage\eMMC\emmc-JESD84-B51 2.pdf. IMPORTANT distinct-document-class warning: several VIP-doc trees (MADV\VIP\Docs, SCB\VIP\Docs, UVM\VIP\Docs, VIP\Docs) each contain emmc_svt_uvm_user_guide.pdf which is a Synopsys VIP USER GUIDE, not the eMMC standard -- do not conflate the two. SD/SDIO: D:\DV\Task\UVM\Spec\SDIO\113311_Part_E1_SDIO_Speciifcation_Ver2.00_Final_070130.pdf, Simplified_SDIO_Card_Spec.pdf, and under a supplementary subfolder: SD_Physical_Layer_Spec.pdf, SD_SDIO_specsv1.pdf. CAN-FD: D:\DV\Task\CAN\Spec\can_fd_spec.pdf, can20.pdf, plus the full ISO 11898 series parts 1-5 (ISO 11898-1 2015.12.15.pdf is the CAN FD data-link-layer standard itself, up to 61MB, genuine scanned standard). Ethernet: D:\DV\Task\Ethernet\Spec\ieee802.3-2015.pdf (base MAC/PHY), ieee802.3br-2016.pdf (frame preemption), ieee802.1Qbu-2016.pdf, ieee802.1Qbv-2015.pdf (TSN time-aware shaping), ieee1588-2008.pdf (PTP). Actual gap: not a material-availability gap for any protocol -- it is a DEEP-EXTRACTION gap. Only USB (this intake pass) has had section-level deep extraction done; the other 8 protocols have real source PDFs sitting completely unextracted. Anyone building generic 'look under <Protocol>\Spec\' tooling must special-case PCIe and AMBA whose real material is under UVM\Spec\ instead.
